aboutPage.title: About ToolNest
aboutPage.description: What ToolNest is, how it works, and who builds it.
aboutPage.whatBody: ToolNest is a collection of {tools} free online tools across {categories} categories — encoding, developer utilities, text, time, colour, images and everyday calculations. It is also the official site of ToolNest, a one-person software company. Every tool is designed to do one small job well, load instantly, and get out of the way.

local.title: Everything runs in your browser
local.body: There is no backend. Text you paste, files you drop and results you copy are processed on your own device and never sent anywhere.

free.title: Free, with no account
free.body: No sign-up, no paywall, no trial. Open a page and use it.

fast.title: Small and fast
fast.body: Pages are static and dependency-light, so they load quickly and keep working on a slow connection.

bilingual.title: Bilingual
bilingual.body: Every page exists in English and Chinese, each with its own address, so either language can be linked and shared directly.

aboutPage.howBody: Next.js and TypeScript with Tailwind CSS, deployed as a static site on Vercel. The conversion logic — CSV parsing, colour maths, the expression evaluator and so on — is written from scratch and unit-tested, rather than pulled in as libraries, which keeps the pages small and the behaviour predictable.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.description: What ToolNest does and does not collect — in plain language.
privacyPage.summary: Short version: ToolNest has no backend, no accounts and no analytics. Whatever you paste into a tool stays on your device.

data.title: The content you work with
data.body: Every tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript on your own device. Text, JSON, images and any other input are never uploaded, never logged, and never leave your computer — the site has no server-side code that could receive them. Closing the tab discards everything.

storage.title: What is stored in your browser
storage.body: Two small things, both purely functional. Your light/dark preference is saved in your browser's local storage under the key "theme", so the site doesn't flash the wrong colours on the next visit. And a cookie named NEXT_LOCALE remembers whether you were reading the English or Chinese version. Neither is used for tracking, neither is sent to a third party, and clearing your browser data removes both.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.body: The site is hosted on Vercel. Like any web host, Vercel processes the technical information every request carries — IP address, browser user agent, the page requested — in order to deliver the page and to protect the service. That data is handled by Vercel under its own privacy policy; ToolNest does not add to it, and does not receive a copy.

analytics.title: No analytics, ads or third-party scripts
analytics.body: There is no analytics service, no advertising, no social widgets and no tracking pixels. Fonts are bundled with the site rather than fetched from a font service, so simply opening a page contacts no one but the host.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If this ever changes — for example if a tool one day needs a server to do its job — this page will say so before the change ships, and the tool will make it obvious what leaves your device.

termsPage.title: Terms of Use
termsPage.description: The rules and responsibilities that apply when you use ToolNest.
termsPage.summary: ToolNest provides free browser-based utilities. By accessing or using the site, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

acceptance.title: Using ToolNest
acceptance.body: You may use ToolNest only if you can legally agree to these terms and your use complies with the laws that apply to you. These terms apply to the website and every tool offered through it.

service.title: What the service provides
service.body: ToolNest offers general-purpose utilities for convenience. The tools do not provide legal, financial, medical or other professional advice. Features may be corrected, changed, added or removed as the site develops.

responsibility.title: Your responsibility
responsibility.body: You are responsible for checking results before relying on them, keeping backups of important content, and deciding whether a tool is suitable for your situation. You must have the right to use any text, image or other material you process and must comply with applicable law.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: Do not use ToolNest to break the law, violate another person's rights, distribute harmful material, interfere with the site, overload its infrastructure, attempt unauthorized access, or bypass security or technical limits.

source.title: Source code and intellectual property
source.body: The site's source code is publicly viewable on GitHub. Reuse is governed by any licence or notice included in that repository; these terms grant no additional rights. ToolNest's name, site content and design remain protected to the extent allowed by law, and third-party names belong to their respective owners.

availability.title: Availability and warranties
availability.body: ToolNest is provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis. To the extent permitted by law, no guarantee is made that the site will always be available, uninterrupted, secure or error-free, or that every result will be accurate or suitable for a particular purpose.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, ToolNest is not responsible for indirect, incidental, special or consequential loss, or for lost data, revenue or business arising from use of, or inability to use, the site. Nothing here excludes liability or consumer rights that applicable law does not allow to be excluded.

thirdParty.title: Third-party services and links
thirdParty.body: The site is hosted by Vercel and may link to external sites such as GitHub. Those services operate under their own terms and privacy practices. ToolNest does not control and is not responsible for third-party content or availability.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: These terms may be updated as ToolNest changes. The updated date will appear on this page, and material changes will be made clear. Changes apply when posted; using the site after that date means accepting the revised terms.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: The Privacy page explains how tools process content locally and what limited technical data the hosting provider handles.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: Questions or concerns about these terms can be raised through the project's public repository:
